name: Consequences Your Actions
source:
Once upon a time was born cursed soul which contained all 12 deadly sins.

When you paid a heavy price for something you have never done, you could hope for a little bit happiness as reward for your suffering.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
从前，诞生了一个被诅咒的灵魂，它包含了所有12种致命的罪孽。

当你为从未做过的事情付出了沉重的代价时，你可能会希望得到一点点幸福作为你痛苦的回报。

[来自Itch.io]
